items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 08 May 2026 at 10:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low to the north of Scotland, slowly moving into the Norwegian Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly northerly 3 or 4, but 4 or 5 in the west of the area, imminently increasing generally north or northeast 4 or 5, but 5 or 6 in the west.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight at first, building slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northeast 4 or 5, but occasionally 6 in the west at first, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight, backing northwest on Sunday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight on Sunday morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
